column2: Sapphire Ventures is a growth-stage venture capital firm based in Austin, Texas, that partners with enterprise AI founders. With more than 15 years of experience and over $10 billion in assets under management, it makes high-conviction investments in a select number of companies.

SV Angel is a San Francisco venture firm that invests early and for the long term. For years its team has helped build some of the world's most transformative companies, backing founders to create impact that reaches beyond business.

Initialized Capital is a seed-stage venture firm in San Francisco that backs founders working on hard problems. It invests across all sectors, on the view that founders know best which technologies and markets will define the future.

Greylock is a Silicon Valley venture capital firm that aims to be the earliest partner to teams building companies that matter. It invests from seed onward, with a long record in enterprise software, AI, cybersecurity and consumer technology.

General Atlantic is a global growth investor headquartered in New York. It positions itself as a long-term partner to entrepreneurs and investors, backing companies across technology, financial services, healthcare, consumer and climate.

F-Prime Capital is a global venture capital firm based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, with a heritage spanning four decades. It invests in life sciences, technology, healthtech and services, and crypto, with a team that includes scientists and operators.

Canaan is an early-stage venture capital firm that has partnered with founders for nearly four decades. It backs companies from fundamental discovery to mass adoption, across breakthrough therapeutics, deep tech, cybersecurity and AI.

venBio Partners is a San Francisco life sciences venture firm founded in 2011. It builds and funds biotech companies with an eye on eventual acquirers from the outset, focusing on intellectual property, manufacturing and clinical trial design.
Venrock is a Palo Alto venture capital firm that invests in technology and healthcare companies. Its message to founders is simple: build the future.

Playground Global is a Palo Alto venture firm that invests in the biggest leaps in engineering and science, describing its sweet spot as somewhere between improbable and impossible. It backs companies pushing computing to new frontiers, from quantum computing and AI acceleration to new chip architectures.

Mayfield is an early-stage venture firm in Menlo Park investing $3 billion in AI companies, and it aims to be the first institutional investor for AI founders. About 70% of its investments begin at inception, and its portfolio has produced 120 IPOs and more than 225 acquisitions.

Innovation Endeavors is an early-stage venture capital firm in Palo Alto built for founders reimagining the technical frontier. It partners with technical founders across AI, computing infrastructure and other deep technology.

USVP is a Menlo Park venture firm focused on early-stage information technology and healthcare investments. Its team of investors, former CEOs and founders has a network of about 500 companies and 5,000 executives.

NEA is a Menlo Park venture capital firm that partners with founders at every stage of company building, from seed to growth. It invests across technology and healthcare and describes each investment as an enduring commitment to the people behind the idea.

ICONIQ is a global investment firm headquartered in San Francisco. Its growth arm invests in category-leading software, AI and fintech companies, and the firm also manages portfolios for influential families and mission-driven institutions.

Future Ventures is a Los Altos venture firm that backs mission-driven founders building the future. It invests in deep tech and frontier science, from space and advanced manufacturing to new ways of producing food.
Bolt was a Boston pre-seed venture capital firm focused on the intersection of software and physical goods. Between 2013 and 2020 it invested in 80 companies across two pre-seed funds.

Amplify Partners is a Menlo Park venture firm that aims to be the first investor for technical founders. It backs founders building the infrastructure of tomorrow, including the next generation of applications, models and developer tools.

ARCH Venture Partners is a Chicago-based venture firm that provides seed and early-stage capital to companies in life sciences, physical sciences and information technology. It focuses on discoveries that prevent, detect and cure disease.

2468 Ventures is a San Diego firm that invests in AI and deep tech startups at the pre-seed and seed stages. It looks for founders who never give up, at the intersection of AI with industrials, health and consumer markets.

Versant Ventures is a San Francisco venture firm that builds and funds breakthrough biotechnology companies around the world. Its Discovery Engines, in-house teams of scientists in dedicated labs, launch new companies from academic research.

Union Square Ventures is a venture capital firm in New York City. For more than two decades it has invested at the edge of large markets being transformed by technology, partnering with companies that build durable new infrastructure and services.
Tiger Global is a New York investment firm with more than 25 years of experience. It describes itself as research-driven, investing in the defining technology companies of the future.

Tidemark is a Menlo Park growth equity firm built to help companies win and scale. It is backed by a community of investors, entrepreneurs and operators, and it focuses on where technology, consumer behavior and business models collide.
Thrive Capital is a New York venture firm that builds and invests in internet, software and technology-enabled companies.

Third Rock Ventures is a Boston healthcare venture firm that advances disruptive areas of science and medicine. It builds companies around new science with the aim of delivering breakthroughs to patients.
TCV is a Menlo Park growth investor that partners with exceptional teams to build category-defining technology companies. Its portfolio has included Netflix.
Sutter Hill Ventures is a venture capital firm in Palo Alto, California, founded in 1962. It is one of the oldest venture firms in Silicon Valley.
Spark Capital is a venture firm that invests in products it loves, built by creators it admires. It backs companies across all sectors and stages, from offices in San Francisco and beyond.

Sofinnova Investments is a Menlo Park venture capital firm focused on clinical-stage biopharmaceutical companies, with about $2 billion in assets under management and committed capital. It deploys human and financial capital to, in its words, turn dreams into drugs.

Sequoia Capital is a Menlo Park venture capital firm that helps the daring build legendary companies from idea to IPO and beyond. It invests from the earliest stages through growth, and it also hosts the Training Data podcast on AI.

Scale Venture Partners is a Foster City, California venture firm that invests in early-stage founders building category-defining businesses. It has backed companies such as DocuSign, HubSpot, Box and CircleCI, and today partners with early-stage AI companies as they move from founder-led growth to scale.

Ribbit Capital is a Palo Alto venture firm known for backing founders who rebuild financial systems. Its view is that the world changes when someone decides a system is broken and has the conviction to build something better.

Revolution is a Washington, D.C. investment firm founded by Steve Case. For more than two decades it has backed companies and communities and worked to advance entrepreneurship across the United States.
Paradigm is a San Francisco frontier technology investment firm. It builds and invests in crypto, AI, robotics and other new frontiers from the earliest stages.

OrbiMed is a New York healthcare investment firm that invests globally in world-class healthcare companies. It provides tailored financing across biopharmaceuticals, medical devices, digital health, diagnostics and healthcare services, with the goal of addressing unmet medical needs.

Oak HC/FT is a growth equity and venture firm in Stamford, Connecticut that works with founders driving structural change in healthcare and financial services. It brings decades of sector experience and deep networks in both industries.

Notable Capital is a Menlo Park venture firm that invests in founders with global ambitions. It aims to back founders before they build the future, with a strong focus on developer tools and infrastructure.

Multicoin Capital is an Austin-based, thesis-driven investment firm that invests in cryptocurrencies, tokens and blockchain companies. It makes long-term, high-conviction investments in category-defining crypto companies and protocols.

Meritech Capital is a Palo Alto growth investor that helps build market-leading companies in the markets that matter. It is a focused group where the partners do the work themselves, favoring deep relationships with founders.

Maverick Ventures is the venture investing arm of Maverick Capital, a global investment firm that applies deep fundamental research across public and private markets. It backs early-stage companies, with a long record in healthcare and technology.

Khosla Ventures is a Menlo Park venture capital firm that helps founders build bold, early, impactful ventures. It invests earliest, from pre-seed and seed to Series A, with conviction in large possibilities.

Inflection Ventures is a New York venture firm that invests in AI infrastructure, defense technology and cybersecurity. It backs later-stage companies that power, defend and secure the country, describing its founders as the ones reindustrializing America.
IVP is a Menlo Park growth-stage venture firm that has backed about 400 breakout companies over four decades. It invests in exceptional companies as they scale.

Haun Ventures is a Menlo Park venture firm that backs builders defining the next generation of the global economy, from seed stage to scale. It focuses on founders building the future of finance with decentralized technology.

HOF Capital is a global multi-stage venture capital firm based in New York City, with more than $15 billion in assets under management. It invests in relentlessly ambitious entrepreneurs from idea to IPO.
Greycroft is a New York venture firm that partners with bold founders in AI, software, sustainability and consumer brands. Its investments span geographies and industries.
Greenoaks is a San Francisco investment firm that acts as a concentrated, long-term partner to extraordinary founders building generational businesses.

Factorial Funds is a Menlo Park firm that makes concentrated technology investments. It invests in the companies defining the AI era, across intelligence, silicon, infrastructure and the power needed to run it.

Dragoneer Investment Group is a San Francisco growth investor that partners with exceptional businesses globally. It focuses on leading growth companies with sustainable differentiation and attractive economic models.

CAVU Consumer Partners is a Santa Monica consumer investor that builds brands for a healthier world. Its mission is to democratize healthy living, and it backs each investment with the CAVU team and ecosystem.
Bedrock is a technology investment firm based in Los Angeles. It backs a small number of founders building ambitious technology companies.

Altimeter is a technology-focused investment firm built by a founder for founders. It manages funds that invest in both public and private markets and aims to be a long-term partner to companies through all stages of growth, including as they go public.
Addition is a New York venture firm that invests in early and growth-stage technology companies. It was founded with a mission to support visionaries building impactful and enduring businesses.

TeleSoft Partners is a venture capital firm in Aspen, Colorado, founded by Arjun Gupta. It provides entrepreneurs with capital, knowledge, contacts and expertise across technology and energy companies.

a16z speedrun is Andreessen Horowitz's accelerator in San Francisco. Twice a year it backs founders with up to $1 million, more than $10 million in credits and an in-house team of operators who build alongside them, with a target two-week close.

Workday Ventures is the corporate venture arm of Workday. It connects next-generation enterprise technology companies with Workday, its customers and the broader community, offering founders capital and expertise.

South Park Commons is a San Francisco community and fund for technologists, builders and domain experts working out what to build next. It helps founders go from "-1 to 0" and backs them through its Founder Fellowship.
Social Capital is a Palo Alto firm founded in 2011 by Chamath Palihapitiya, an early Facebook executive. It makes big bets on transformational ideas, technology and people.

Shasta Ventures is a Menlo Park early-stage venture capital firm with $1.3 billion under management and a 20-year track record. It partners with founders early, bringing capital, insight and support built on trust.

Salesforce Ventures is the investment arm of Salesforce, based in San Francisco. Since 2009 it has backed more than 400 enterprise software companies from seed to IPO, including Airtable, Databricks and DocuSign.

Radical Ventures is a Toronto-based venture firm that invests in AI companies. Its portfolio ranges from companies automating scientific discovery to builders of real-time world models and spatial intelligence.

Peak XV Partners is a venture capital firm with more than 20 years of experience partnering with founders to build enduring companies. It invests across stages and borders, with a strong base in India and Southeast Asia.
Okta Ventures is the corporate venture arm of Okta, the identity and security company. It invests in early-stage companies building around identity, security and access.
Next47 is the venture firm backed by Siemens. It invests when the product speaks loudest, before the buzz and the metrics, and helps bold builders grow from belief to scale.

Lockheed Martin Ventures is the venture capital arm of Lockheed Martin, the global security, defense and aerospace company. It invests in early-stage companies developing technology relevant to aerospace and defense.

Emerson Collective is a Palo Alto organization that invests in entrepreneurs and innovators driven by purpose and possibility. It works across education, climate, health and media toward what it calls a world of abundance for future generations.

Emergence Capital is a San Mateo venture capital firm focused on early-stage B2B software. It partners with founders transforming the way the world works, aiming to help companies go from emerging to iconic.

Dell Technologies Capital is the venture arm of Dell Technologies, based in Palo Alto. Since 2012 it has led early-stage investments in companies building the future of enterprise technology, including infrastructure, security and AI.

Contrarian Ventures is a European early-stage investor based in Vilnius, Lithuania. It backs founders electrifying and automating the physical economy, across energy, compute, materials, robotics and industry.

Bloomberg Beta is a San Francisco venture fund backed by Bloomberg that invests at early stages in companies that make business work better. It has published and open-sourced an operating manual explaining how the fund works.

Analog Ventures is an idea-stage venture capital firm. It writes the first check to startups reshaping foundational industries, from healthcare and financial services to energy and the way people work.

Abstract Ventures is a San Francisco venture capital firm with $3.3 billion in assets under management. It is sector-agnostic and invests in seed and early-stage companies, and founders know it for loyalty, connections and a drive to help them win.

AI Grant is a San Francisco accelerator for seed-stage AI startups. It looks for technical, pragmatic founders building useful or engaging products on top of AI models, who understand that a new product is 1% idea and 99% iteration.

Wireframe Ventures is a seed venture capital firm for technology founders driven by a mission to build a healthier and more sustainable future. It invests capital, time and belief to help founders succeed.

Verve Ventures is a Swiss venture investor that has backed Europe's most transformative deep tech companies for 15 years. It focuses on health and bio, the future of computing, and energy and resources.
VentureFriends is an early-stage European venture firm based in Greece. It writes first tickets of €500K to €3M at pre-seed and seed for ambitious founders across Europe and MENA.

UVC Partners is a German venture capital firm that partners with B2B startups across Europe from their earliest stages up to Series A. It initially invests €500,000 to €10 million and continues to support companies for the long haul.

Syndicate One is a Belgian community of founders, operators and venture capitalists working to elevate the Belgian tech ecosystem. It provides seed capital along with hands-on operational advice, mentorship and access to its network.

Supernode Ventures is a venture fund founded in 2017 by Laurel Touby, a former founder and investor, and now co-led with Jessica Federer. It invests in women-led companies, and its first fund backed more than 50 early-stage companies in fintech, healthtech and B2B software.
StageOne Ventures is an Israeli seed-stage venture firm that leads investments in Israel-related entrepreneurs. It focuses on transformative deep tech startups solving complex enterprise challenges.

Spero Ventures is a boutique venture firm built for purpose-led companies. It backs founders using technology to tackle humanity's biggest challenges, on the view that tomorrow's most valuable companies will be the ones solving today's most meaningful problems.

SmartFin Capital is a Belgian venture capital fund that invests in European B2B technology companies. It offers founders capital along with clear feedback and guidance from people who have built companies before.

Simon Capital is a German venture firm that invests in driven founders reshaping their industries for a sustainable next generation. Its portfolio has included Waterdrop, the Austrian "microdrink" brand.

Senovo is a European early-stage venture firm in Germany that invests €1-5 million in B2B enterprise software at seed and Series A. It focuses on AI-first products, cybersecurity and industrial technology.
Onto Ventures (formerly ReGen Ventures) is an Australian venture firm that backs founders engineering solutions to existential challenges in climate, food, water and energy.

Presto Ventures is a Czech venture firm that connects frontier technologies, strategic investment and purpose to create a safer, more secure future. It backs tech entrepreneurs working where software alone cannot solve the challenge.

Pi Labs is a UK venture firm, founded in 2015, that backs innovators transforming the built world and its impact on people, business and the environment. It invests globally from pre-seed to Series A.
One Peak is a UK growth investor with more than $4 billion in assets under management, backing entrepreneurs building iconic software scale-ups. Its portfolio has included Neo4j, Keepit and Spryker.
Octopus Ventures is a UK venture capital firm that invests in the people, ideas and industries that will change the world. It backs founders building a better tomorrow, from pre-seed to Series B.
Northzone is a multi-stage venture capital firm operating across Europe and the US. Since 1996 it has backed more than 250 companies, including Spotify, Klarna, Spring Health and Black Forest Labs.
Meron Capital is a Tel Aviv seed fund that leads pre-seed and seed rounds for Israeli founders building category-defining companies. It works out of Herzl 2, the 1909 house of Tel Aviv's founder.

Mendoza Ventures is a US venture fund that invests in technology companies modernizing financial services, insurance and manufacturing, with a focus on AI, cybersecurity and fintech. It was started by Adrian and Senofer Mendoza after a technology exit and now runs three funds.

MPM Capital, through MPM BioImpact, builds and supports companies that transform patient outcomes. It invests in private and public companies across the drug development process, turning scientific breakthroughs into life-saving medicines.

Lumira Ventures is Canada's largest life sciences venture capital firm, headquartered in Toronto. It invests in healthcare innovators from early-stage to revenue-generating companies in biotech, biotherapeutics and medical devices.

Lead Edge Capital is a growth equity firm investing in software, internet and tech-enabled businesses. It is backed by a network of more than 700 investors, including successful executives and entrepreneurs.

Laton Ventures is a Turkish venture firm focused on gaming and apps, backed by more than 35 gaming industry veterans. It invests at pre-seed and seed in mobile, cross-platform and AI-enhanced games and apps worldwide.
La Famiglia is a European seed and growth-stage venture capital fund based in Germany. It backs tech entrepreneurs across Europe and the US, with a focus on B2B software.
Jerusalem Venture Partners (JVP) is an Israeli venture firm with $1.9 billion in assets under management and 165 companies built. It invests in AI, cybersecurity, fintech, insurtech and climate tech.
Industry Ventures is a US venture firm that has pioneered flexible capital across the venture life cycle since 2000, from seed and early-stage investing to secondaries.
HIRO Capital is a founder-led European venture fund investing from Series A to scale-up. Its areas include spatial AI, deep tech, next-generation cloud, robotics, games, space and defence.
Highland Europe provides growth capital to exceptional software and internet teams across Europe. It recently raised a €1.1 billion sixth fund and led rounds such as Adaptyv's $40 million Series A.

Hetz Ventures is an Israeli seed-stage venture firm with $500 million in assets under management. It leads rounds in AI, data infrastructure and cybersecurity, and its exits include Granulate, Prompt Security and Silk Security.
Headline is a global venture capital firm with teams across the US, Europe, Asia and Brazil. It invests across software, AI, consumer and fintech, and leads rounds at every stage.

HV Capital is a German venture capital firm that provides capital and conviction to founders. It started in the early 2000s with consumer internet, expanded into enterprise software and fintech, and now also backs deep tech; portfolio company Exein recently became Europe's most valuable cybersecurity startup.

Grove Ventures is an early-stage venture capital fund in Israel that partners with seed and early-stage founders. It positions itself as more than funding, with a team that builds alongside its companies.

Greenfield Partners is a global fund focused on early growth-stage technology and tech-enabled businesses, with a dual presence in New York and Tel Aviv. Its team combines investing and operating experience, deep Israeli roots and a global network.
Graham & Walker is an early-stage venture capital firm that invests in mission-driven founders who break the VC mold. It backs authentic, relentless builders with power-law potential.
Golden Ventures is a seed-stage venture capital fund based in Toronto that invests across North America. It backs bold teams and their transformative ideas, including Canadian fintech Float.

Glilot Capital Partners is an Israeli venture firm that invests in seed, Series A and Series B enterprise software, cybersecurity and AI companies. It has raised $1.3 billion and supports founders across the company lifecycle.

Genesys Capital is one of Canada's leading venture capital firms, investing in early-stage healthcare and biotechnology companies. It has more than 25 years of experience backing medical breakthroughs.

Future Energy Ventures is a German venture firm that partners with ambitious founders building the future energy system. It believes the future of energy will be defined by electrification and orchestration across power, transport, buildings, industry and digital infrastructure.

Fusion is a venture fund and accelerator for Israeli startups expanding to the US. It provides early-stage founders with their first institutional capital and a support system to scale in the US market.

Fuel Ventures is a UK venture firm created by entrepreneurs for entrepreneurs. Its funds invest between £150,000 and £3 million in tech companies with early commercial traction, with a focus on marketplaces, platforms and SaaS.

Foundamental is a venture firm in Germany that is the first partner to founders re-creating the real world, with a focus on construction and the built environment. It invests as early as day zero, leading first institutional rounds with first checks of $500,000 to $5 million.
Forbion is a global venture capital firm based in the Netherlands, dedicated to advancing groundbreaking biotech innovations and other sustainable solutions that improve human health and the planet.
Focal is a venture firm that exclusively backs AI-native builders at inception, with speed and conviction. It aims to be the first believer for technical founders with moonshot ambitions.
Endeit Capital is a Dutch growth investor that helps Europe's scale-ups grow into global leaders. Its portfolio includes companies such as Rabot Energy and Noah.

EnBW New Ventures is the venture capital arm of German energy company EnBW. It supports entrepreneurs building sustainable solutions, combining a financially driven VC approach with the reach and skills of its corporate parent.
Droia Ventures is a Luxembourg-based specialist life sciences investor dedicated to saving patient lives. It invests globally in young drug development companies using novel science.
DFJ Growth, founded in 2005, invests in emerging technology leaders during their scaling phase. It partners with mission-driven entrepreneurs building game-changing companies.
Crosslink Capital is an early-stage venture capital firm that partners with ambitious founders building category-defining companies. It invests in enterprise software, cybersecurity, AI and fintech.
Credo Ventures is a venture fund for founders from Central and Eastern Europe building generational companies. It has led pre-seed and early rounds in the region since 2009.

Conductive Ventures backs unconventional, often-overlooked founders building capital-efficient companies in diverse geographies. It invests mostly at Series A and Series B in emerging category leaders.
Closed Loop Partners is a US investment firm dedicated to accelerating the transition to a circular economy. It invests in, builds and operates businesses that are both profitable and sustainable.

CapitalT is a European venture capital firm in the Netherlands that puts founders first. It believes the category leaders of the next decade will combine commercial success with a positive contribution to people and the planet.
Camber Creek is a US venture firm that invests in technology for real estate and the built world. Its portfolio includes software for property inspection, insurance data and fraud detection.
BlueYard Capital is a German venture firm that backs founders building the fabric of the future, from breakthroughs in computation, software, engineering and biology to crypto networks.

Bison Ventures invests in early-stage frontier technology companies focused on healthier people and a healthier planet. It partners with founders pushing the frontier of intelligence into the physical world.
Bek Ventures is a Turkish venture firm that calls itself quietly thought-provoking, staying silent most of the time except when it counts. It invests from pre-seed to Series B.
Balderton Capital is a London venture firm that has worked with hundreds of European founders over 26 years. It has raised more than $5.7 billion across 12 funds.

BMW i Ventures is the venture arm of BMW, operating with the speed of a Silicon Valley VC while drawing on BMW as a corporate partner. Its portfolio includes Xometry, the on-demand manufacturing platform.

Axon Partners Group is a Spanish investment and advisory firm that partners with visionary leaders building technology-driven businesses during a time of major social, economic and environmental change.

Axeleo Capital is a Paris-based investment firm with €300 million under management, backing European B2B software and industrial greentech from pre-seed to Series B. It has made more than 70 investments and seen more than 20 exits.

Astanor Ventures is a Belgian investor working to transform the agrifood system "from soil and sea to gut". It scales businesses across the sector through two strategies, Astanor Venture and Astanor Growth.

The Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund is a $1 billion corporate venture capital fund that invests directly in emerging technology companies. It focuses on innovation that improves the employee and customer experience in Amazon's operations.

Alpine Space Ventures is a German venture capital firm led by industry insiders that invests exclusively in early-stage space companies. Its portfolio includes Northwood Space, which builds ground infrastructure for satellites.

Allianz X is the investment arm of Allianz, based in Germany. It invests in mature digital frontrunners in ecosystems relevant to insurance and asset management, from fintech and health to mobility and cybersecurity.

AgFunder is a global venture capital firm backing deep tech platforms across AI, biotech, robotics, manufacturing, climate and materials. It focuses on the limiting factors for food, agriculture and planetary health.
Activant Capital is a research-led global investment firm that partners with high-growth founders building category-defining technology companies, through their most defining stages of growth.

1kx is a research-driven global crypto investment firm working to make trust instant, open and programmable. It has made more than 160 investments since 2018 across DeFi, stablecoins and onchain infrastructure.

1991 Ventures has backed Ukrainian startups since 2016. Its accelerator has supported more than 315 startups that raised over $60 million, and its £15 million seed fund invests in founders from Central and Eastern Europe and Ukraine.

10x Founders is a German venture firm built by entrepreneurs, super angels and early-stage investors. It supports ambitious founders building global businesses, drawing on decades of experience as operators and CEOs.

.406 Ventures is a Boston venture firm that partners with early-stage companies with home-run potential. For 20 years it has worked closely with founders to turn their companies into category leaders.
Worklife is a San Francisco venture capital firm founded by Brianne Kimmel. It calls itself the first creator-friendly VC firm and invests in tools and services for the modern workplace.

Will Ventures is a Boston early-stage venture firm that invests in category-defining consumer, health and media businesses. Its team of entrepreneurs, operators and investors describes itself as competitors with a hustle-first mentality.
VoLo Earth Ventures is a Denver-based venture firm that provides first-in funding and hands-on leadership to companies driving an economics-led transformation of the global energy economy.

VSC Ventures is a Zurich-based venture fund that backs audacious founders and amplifies their stories. It builds portfolio companies' brands and runs a media operation to help them win faster with customers, employees and investors.

Unshackled Ventures is a Palo Alto firm that writes the first check for "Day 0" founders. It backs bold technical founders, many of them immigrants, with capital, immigration support and conviction, often before product, revenue or visa.
Sfermion is a Chicago multi-strategy investment firm focused on the immersive internet. It invests in the founders, companies and assets accelerating the merger of the physical and digital worlds.

SJF Ventures is a Durham, North Carolina venture firm that invests in high-growth companies creating a healthier, smarter and cleaner future. Its mission is to build highly successful businesses that drive lasting, positive change.

Quona Capital is a Washington, D.C. venture firm that invests in fintech innovators advancing financial inclusion around the world. It aims to deliver strong financial returns while making a lasting positive impact.

Owl Ventures is a San Francisco venture firm and a global leader in edtech investing, with $2.2 billion under management across seven funds. It backs AI-driven learning and workforce companies at every stage.
Operator Partners is a New York firm that invests only its own capital, with no outside LPs. It backs technology companies at pre-seed, seed and Series A and partners with founders it can help win.
K9 Ventures is a technology-focused micro VC fund based in Palo Alto, California. Its portfolio companies share a passion for using technology to solve real problems.
Interlock Partners is a Dallas venture capital firm that invests in companies positioned to win. It accelerates success through a hands-on approach drawn from its operating experience.

Heritage Group is a Nashville healthcare investor that partners with companies addressing healthcare's greatest challenges. It is backed by leading US healthcare organizations that take an active role in supporting its portfolio, and its team has more than 35 years of experience as entrepreneurs and investors.

Heartland Ventures is a South Bend, Indiana venture firm that invests in cutting-edge technology for industrial businesses. It connects early-stage startups with its network of industrial companies and industry experts.
Harpoon Ventures is a San Diego venture firm that backs founders building mission-critical technologies. It invests across AI, deep tech, software infrastructure and cybersecurity.

GoAhead Ventures is a pre-seed and seed venture firm in Menlo Park that operates at startup speed. Founders complete a one-way pitch reviewed by all managing partners, and final decisions come the day after the partner pitch.
Future\Perfect Ventures is a New York early-stage venture firm founded in 2014 by Jalak Jobanputra. It invests globally in blockchain technology and crypto assets.
Foundation Capital is a Palo Alto venture firm that has backed extraordinary founders from day zero for thirty years. Its portfolio has included Solana.

Engineering Capital is a Palo Alto seed firm that partners with entrepreneurs driven by technical insight. It leads seed rounds before traditional venture firms are willing, in companies defining new categories in information technology.

DigiTx Partners is a San Francisco venture firm investing in digital health and data-driven companies. It partners with founders using technology and meaningful data to improve healthcare and patient outcomes.

Cisco Investments is the venture arm of Cisco. It invests in enterprise technology startups where Cisco has deep expertise, helping them grow into enterprises with access to Cisco's global development expertise.

CMFG Ventures, now TruStage Ventures, is the venture capital arm of TruStage, based in Madison, Wisconsin. It invests in the next generation of financial technology to help credit union members achieve better financial security.
Builders VC is a San Francisco venture firm backing founders solving complex, mission-critical problems with technology that transforms legacy systems in essential industries such as healthcare.
Booz Allen Ventures is the venture arm of Booz Allen Hamilton. It invests in technologies that advance critical civil, defense and national security missions.
Blockchange Ventures is a venture fund designed to invest in the early rounds of the largest blockchain outcomes. It backs founders whose visions are as big as the blockchain shift itself.
Arrington Capital is a thesis-driven venture capital firm investing in digital assets and Web3 technology. Since 2017 it has invested in more than 200 early-stage crypto companies.
Amino Capital is a Palo Alto venture firm that invests at pre-seed, seed, Series A and Series B. It backs data-driven technology startups.

Air Street Capital is a London venture capital firm founded in 2019 by Nathan Benaich. It invests exclusively in AI-first companies across frontier AI, infrastructure, autonomy, defense technology and TechBio, and recently announced a $232 million fund.
Zetta Venture Partners backs founders pushing the frontier of AI in science and building tools for discovery. It provides day-zero capital and hands-on support to scientific founders.
Vektor Partners is a UK venture firm investing in critical technologies driving the world's shift toward AI, automation and decarbonization, with a focus on AI and software-enabled businesses.
VGames is an Israeli founder-first venture fund investing in gaming and consumer startups. It backs game studios, apps and consumer companies from inception to growth.
Upside Partnership is a seed and pre-seed venture capital firm that believes early investing is about people. It looks for "inevitable founders" who want investors who work for them.
TLV Partners is an Israeli venture firm that invests in early-stage startups. Since 2015 it has backed Israeli founders from day zero to build category-defining companies.

SE Ventures is the venture fund backed by Schneider Electric, based in France. It acts as a growth engine for founders who can benefit from Schneider Electric's global customer base and domain expertise in energy and industry.
Plural is a UK venture community of regulatory experts, operators and investors. It provides early-stage companies with investment and intellectual capital to build the future of finance.
Next Gear Ventures is an Israeli venture fund focused on entrepreneurs pioneering sustainable, smart mobility. It supports early-stage ventures with an ecosystem designed to help them scale.
Myriad Venture Partners provides capital, insights and an ecosystem to entrepreneurs building enduring companies that define industries, with a focus on business solutions.
Munich Re Ventures is the venture arm of reinsurer Munich Re. It works globally as a strategic and financial investor in disruptive technologies and business models that shape the future of risk.
Morningside makes venture capital investments in companies built on novel science and technology.
Middleland Capital is a thematic venture fund investing in foodtech and agtech companies working to catalyze global change in food and health.

Maven11 is an Amsterdam-based blockchain investment firm with ten years in digital assets. It invests in the protocols, platforms and applications defining the next wave of global finance, particularly DeFi, payments and financial infrastructure.
Latitude is a UK venture investor that connects the fastest-growing startups with the world's biggest companies.

Lanchi Ventures is a venture capital firm in China that backs daring entrepreneurs using technology to redefine the future. It invests in early-stage startups across AI, robotics, consumer, biotech and healthcare, managing multiple funds with more than $2 billion in assets.
Koch Disruptive Technologies is the venture and growth investment arm of Koch. It helps entrepreneurs innovate and scale with flexible capital and access to its global partner community.

Kinnevik is a Swedish growth investor that acts as an entrepreneurial investor, active owner and operational partner to challenger companies in Europe and the US. It provides patient capital to build remarkable growth companies.
Ironspring Ventures is an early-stage venture firm investing across the industrial supply chain. It backs startups in construction, manufacturing, transport and logistics, and alternative energy.
Icon Ventures is a venture firm that believes AI is reshaping every industry and that startups need partners who know how to create enduring value, not just capital.

Hatteras Venture Partners is a healthcare venture capital firm investing in biotech, medtech and healthtech companies advancing patient care. Its team of entrepreneurs and scientists invests broadly across healthcare.
Hack VC is a venture capital firm that invests in Web3 and crypto companies.

Graph Ventures is an early-stage fund for founders, run by founders. It invests when companies are starting out and draws on more than 10 years of investing and company building to help founders close their rounds.

GP Bullhound is a UK technology investment and advisory firm that has invested in and advised founders since 1999. It has more than 180 employees across 13 offices worldwide and advises on M&A, exits and growth capital.

GMO Venture Partners is the Japanese venture arm of the GMO Internet Group, with a focus on fintech. It recently held a first close of its GMO Fintech Fund 8, and portfolio company Rentomojo has listed on India's stock exchanges.
Forestay Capital is a Geneva-based growth investor backing enterprise AI and SaaS companies at their inflection point. It leads Series A to Series C rounds across Europe, Israel and the US.
Foresite Capital is a multi-stage healthcare and life sciences investment firm. It invests in companies that use biology and big data to transform healthcare, in areas of great unmet need.
Fall Line Capital is a specialist investment firm with deep roots in the global food system, investing in venture capital and real assets. It backs exceptional founders building the future of food.
FPV Ventures invests in mission-driven founders who are in it for the long haul. It aims to be with them from the start and support them through the long, often lonely work of building.

Emerald Technology Ventures is a Swiss venture firm that invests in sustainable industrial innovation. It backs startups solving global problems and connects them with corporations looking to accelerate innovation.
Dawn Capital is a UK venture firm that backs B2B software founders. It describes itself as thoughtful rather than theatrical, opening doors and unlocking talent for its companies.
The Creator Fund is a UK venture firm that backs scientific founders creating businesses that will rewrite how the world works, on the belief that the future will be built by scientists.
Coughdrop Capital is an early-stage venture firm founded by brothers Austin Petersmith and Stu Smith. It makes investment decisions within 24 hours of meeting founders.

Correlation Ventures is a venture firm that uses data science and industry networks to make investment decisions within days. Its portfolio has included Synthorx, Personal Capital and Imperfect Foods.

Cathay Innovation is a global, multi-stage venture capital firm based in France that connects ambitious startups with Fortune 500 corporate ecosystems. It backs founders building technologies that rewire how people live and work.
Cardumen Capital is an Israeli early-stage venture firm that invests in visionary founders transforming the world through technology, with a focus on AI, cybersecurity and software infrastructure.

Calibrate Ventures backs founders scaling deep tech to transform industries such as manufacturing, security and warehousing. It funds AI, computer vision, machine learning, robotics and automation startups.
Breakthrough Energy Ventures empowers innovators building the future of energy. Its portfolio spans the clean industrial revolution, from carbon removal and storage to new energy technologies.
Alpha Edison is an investment firm that partners with early-stage entrepreneurs using technology to build category-creating companies that unlock new markets.
10D is an Israeli venture firm that gives its companies access to talent and design partners beyond their own networks. Its portfolio has included DriveNets.
WndrCo builds and backs the companies defining what comes next. It is a venture firm, holding company and founder community based in Silicon Valley and New York.
Rocketship.vc is a Los Altos venture firm that combines founder experience with data science and a large database of startup activity. Its partners wrote a widely used textbook on data mining.
Quiet Capital is a San Francisco venture firm of builders who invest in remarkable founders from day zero.

GreatPoint Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm in San Francisco founded by entrepreneurs and company builders. It aims to give founders the kind of hands-on support its partners valued when building their own companies.

Base10 Partners is a San Francisco venture firm investing in automation for the real economy. Its founders have built companies worth more than $3 billion combined, and the firm donates 50% of its profits to the next generation of technology founders.

Catapult Ventures is an independent UK fund manager whose owners have run venture capital funds totaling about £130 million for public and private investors. It supports entrepreneurs and business owners in reaching their goals.
